desc:
TIKTOK Vs INSTA-GRAM BOSSES PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game.

Escape the prison by completing 25 exciting obstacle stages filled with fun jumps and parkour challenges.
Run, jump, and dodge your way through the course while choosing which side you’re on — Coca-Cola Boss or Pepsi Boss!

Play solo or team up with friends.
Race to the finish, beat your best time, and see how you rank on the leaderboard.

Bright, colorful obstacles and smooth controls make this game family-friendly and enjoyable for players of all ages.
